main_idea: BAR spans 5,161 legal cases across 28 practice areas.
ideas: BAR is a benchmark built around real legal work
summary: Mostly clean, with a generic slogan headline, a chart frame, and a tagline to remove; the grid's cells and colours are unexplained, and the AI-agent subject is never named.

missing.why: Reader cannot tell what each cell or the grey/green split represents.
Reader is not told the benchmark tests AI agents on legal work.
Green versus grey marks have no legend or label saying what they distinguish.
